anchor_definitions: Each anchor is a suggested render/depth-sort pivot. A building anchor estimates ground contact; engine-specific footprint remains to be authored.
lore_basis: Dolly Sisters is a distinct historic neighbourhood with a central eight-street square, local festivals, amateur theatre and a Watch station. Specific architecture and props are original art direction.
